purpose: Resident-facing example illustrations for bag types and disposal methods.

display_policy.note_en: Example illustration for identifying the required bag or disposal method. Actual appearance may vary.
display_policy.note_ja: 指定袋や排出方法を確認するための参考イラストです。実際の外観とは異なる場合があります。

designated_orange_bag.label_en: Designated orange bag for burnable waste
designated_orange_bag.label_ja: 燃やすごみ用の指定袋

transparent_or_translucent_bag.label_ja: 透明または半透明の袋
method_signals: 透明または半透明の袋

paper_tied_with_string.label_en: Paper separated by type and tied with string
paper_tied_with_string.label_ja: 種類ごとに分けてひもで縛った紙類

designated_green_bag.label_en: Designated green bag for unburnable waste
designated_green_bag.label_ja: 燃やさないごみ用の指定袋

selection_rules.rule: The tied-paper illustration requires recyclable category plus an explicit tying instruction in preparation text.
Generic recyclable bag_or_method text cannot trigger the tied-paper illustration.
Transparent-bag signals may select the transparent illustration when no exact tied-paper preparation instruction applies.
Category fallback is disabled for tied paper and retained only for unambiguous bag categories.
If no illustration is clearly compatible with verified guidance, display no illustration.
